title: Beijing Local Guide
subtitle: A dense city of imperial memory, contemporary art, fast transit, and late-night neighborhoods
subtitleCn: 一座把帝都记忆、当代艺术、快速交通与夜生活街区压缩在一起的城市

locations.name: Quanjude Roast Duck (Qianmen Branch)
locations.description: A classic entry point into Beijing cuisine; the Qianmen branch remains one of the city's signature roast duck dining rooms.
locations.descriptionCn: 经典的北京味觉入口，前门店仍是城市最具代表性的烤鸭餐厅之一。
locations.address: No. 30 Qianmen Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区前门大街30号
tips: Go early for lunch or book dinner in advance.
Order roast duck first, then add lighter Beijing dishes.
tipsCn: 建议午餐早点到，晚餐尽量提前预约。
先点烤鸭，再搭配几道清爽京味小菜。

locations.name: Siji Minfu Roast Duck (Forbidden City Branch)
locations.nameCn: 四季民福烤鸭店（故宫店）
locations.description: A popular modern roast duck room near the Forbidden City, often recommended when visitors want Beijing duck in a polished setting.
locations.descriptionCn: 靠近故宫的热门现代烤鸭店，适合想在更舒适环境中体验北京烤鸭的访客。
locations.address: No. 11 Nanchizi Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区南池子大街11号
tips: Reserve ahead because queues can get long.
Ask for window seating if you want a more memorable first visit.
tipsCn: 建议提前预约，排队通常较长。
如果是第一次来，可以争取靠窗位置提升体验。

locations.name: Fangzhuanchang 69 Zhajiangmian
locations.description: One of the city's best-known bowls of old Beijing zhajiangmian, good when you want something iconic but fast.
locations.descriptionCn: 北京最知名的老北京炸酱面之一，适合想快速吃到代表性本地味道的时候。
locations.address: No. 69 Fangzhuanchang Hutong, Xicheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市西城区方砖厂胡同69号
tips: Go off-peak if you want a faster table.
Pair zhajiangmian with a few cold dishes instead of over-ordering.
tipsCn: 想快点吃到的话尽量避开高峰。
炸酱面搭配几道凉菜就够，不必一次点太多。

locations.name: Niujie Snack Street
locations.description: A compact area for halal Beijing snacks, pastries, and quick local comfort food.
locations.descriptionCn: 适合集中体验清真北京小吃、点心和家常口味的一片街区。
locations.address: Around Niujie, Xicheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市西城区牛街周边
tips: Go hungry and order small portions from several shops.
Weekday afternoons are easier than weekend evenings.
tipsCn: 建议空着肚子来，每家少点一点更划算。
工作日下午通常比周末晚上轻松。

locations.name: Da Dong Roast Duck (Dongsi Branch)
locations.description: A more refined roast duck option, known for a lighter style and strong service for guests hosting friends or family.
locations.descriptionCn: 更精致的烤鸭选择，以相对轻盈的做法和稳定服务见长，适合请客。
locations.address: No. 22A Dongsishitiao, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区东四十条甲22号
tips: Good for business dinners or family-style ordering.
Book ahead if you want peak dinner hours.
tipsCn: 适合商务晚餐或多人合菜。
如果想约黄金晚餐时段，建议提前订位。

locations.name: Temple of Heaven
locations.description: A Ming-Qing imperial ritual complex where emperors prayed for harvests; one of Beijing's clearest expressions of ceremonial urban planning.
locations.descriptionCn: 明清两代皇帝祭天祈谷的礼制建筑群，也是北京礼制空间最清晰的代表之一。
locations.address: No. 7 Tiantan East Road, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区天坛东路7号
tips: Morning visits are calmer and better for photography.
Foreign visitors can book tickets in advance with passport details.
tipsCn: 建议上午前往，人更少也更适合拍照。
外籍访客可提前用护照信息预约门票。

locations.name: The Palace Museum
locations.description: The most concentrated expression of imperial Beijing, with layered palace architecture and one of the city's deepest historical atmospheres.
locations.descriptionCn: 最浓缩的帝都北京体验之一，宫殿建筑层层展开，历史氛围极强。
locations.address: No. 4 Jingshan Front Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区景山前街4号
tips: Book timed-entry tickets early; walk-ins are not reliable.
Enter with a route in mind or the scale can be overwhelming.
tipsCn: 建议尽早预约时段票，现场购票并不稳妥。
进门前最好先想好路线，不然很容易逛到失焦。

locations.name: National Museum of China
locations.description: A huge survey of Chinese civilization and state history, useful when you want context rather than just iconic architecture.
locations.descriptionCn: 系统理解中国文明与国家历史的重量级博物馆，适合补足背景脉络。
locations.address: No. 16 East Chang'an Avenue, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区东长安街16号
tips: Prioritize a few halls instead of trying to cover everything.
Bring ID and reserve ahead on busy dates.
tipsCn: 建议先选几个重点展厅，不要试图一次看完。
热门日期请提前预约并带好证件。

locations.name: Yonghe Temple
locations.description: Beijing's most significant Tibetan Buddhist temple, combining incense, ritual movement, and unusually intact Qing-era architecture.
locations.descriptionCn: 北京最重要的藏传佛教寺院之一，香火、仪式感与清代建筑保存得都很完整。
locations.address: No. 12 Yonghegong Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区雍和宫大街12号
tips: Dress and behave conservatively because it remains an active religious site.
Go early if you want a quieter atmosphere.
tipsCn: 这里仍是活跃宗教场所，衣着和举止尽量克制。
如果想感受更安静的氛围，建议早点到。

locations.name: Confucian Temple and Imperial College Museum
locations.description: A calmer cultural stop near Yonghe Temple that helps explain Beijing's scholarly and examination traditions.
locations.descriptionCn: 靠近雍和宫、相对安静的文化点位，能把北京的礼学与科举传统讲得更清楚。
locations.address: No. 15 Guozijian Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区国子监街15号
tips: Pair it with Yonghe Temple on the same half-day route.
The side courtyards are often quieter than the main axis.
tipsCn: 很适合和雍和宫安排在同一个半天。
主轴之外的侧院通常更安静。

locations.name: 798 Art District
locations.description: Beijing's best-known contemporary art district, where galleries, industrial-era factory buildings, cafes, and bookstores all collapse into one walkable zone.
locations.descriptionCn: 北京最知名的当代艺术街区，画廊、工业遗址、咖啡馆与书店在同一片步行区域中交织。
locations.address: No. 4 Jiuxianqiao Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市朝阳区酒仙桥路4号
tips: Reserve at least half a day if you want both exhibitions and cafes.
Weekday afternoons feel less crowded than weekends.
tipsCn: 如果想兼顾看展和咖啡，建议至少预留半天。
工作日下午通常比周末轻松。

locations.name: UCCA Center for Contemporary Art
locations.description: The anchor institution inside 798, useful if you want one reliable stop with stronger curatorial consistency.
locations.descriptionCn: 798内部最稳定的核心机构之一，如果只想选一个看展点，它通常是最稳妥的选择。
locations.address: 4 Jiuxianqiao Road, 798 Art District, Chaoyang District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市朝阳区798艺术区酒仙桥路4号
tips: Check current exhibitions before you go.
Plan extra time for the bookstore and nearby cafes.
tipsCn: 出发前建议先看当前展览。
可以把书店和附近咖啡馆一起算进时间里。

locations.name: Red Brick Art Museum
locations.description: A destination-scale museum where architecture and garden design matter almost as much as the exhibitions.
locations.descriptionCn: 建筑与园林本身就值得专程前往的美术馆，空间体验几乎和展览同等重要。
locations.address: No. 1 Hegezhuang Village, Cuigezhuang Township, Chaoyang District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市朝阳区崔各庄乡何各庄村1号
tips: Best as a dedicated trip rather than a quick add-on.
Photography is often strongest in the courtyards and corridors.
tipsCn: 更适合作为专门行程，而不是顺路插入。
最出片的通常是庭院和回廊。

locations.name: Guardian Art Center
locations.description: An art-and-auction venue near Wangfujing that works well when you want a central-city art stop without going east to 798.
locations.descriptionCn: 位于王府井附近的艺术与拍卖复合空间，适合不想专门跑到798时作为市中心艺术点位。
locations.address: No. 1 Wangfujing Avenue, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区王府井大街1号
tips: Check whether exhibitions are public before arriving.
Easy to pair with Wangfujing or the East Chang'an cultural axis.
tipsCn: 出发前最好确认当期展览是否对公众开放。
很适合和王府井、长安街东段安排在一起。

locations.name: Today Art Museum
locations.description: A familiar contemporary venue in the CBD fringe, often easier to combine with shopping, coffee, or evening plans nearby.
locations.descriptionCn: 位于国贸边缘、使用频率很高的当代艺术场馆，适合和咖啡、购物或晚间安排连起来。
locations.address: No. 32 Baiziwan Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市朝阳区百子湾路32号
tips: Good as a shorter art stop on a busy day.
Best paired with CBD or Sanlitun plans afterward.
tipsCn: 如果当天行程很满，这里适合做较短的艺术停留。
逛完之后很适合继续接CBD或三里屯安排。

locations.name: Beijing Olympic Forest Park
locations.nameCn: 北京奥林匹克森林公园
locations.description: The city's largest urban park, stretching north from the Olympic Green with broad lawns, lakes, and easy breathing room after dense central districts.
locations.descriptionCn: 北京最大的城市公园，从奥林匹克绿地向北展开，拥有开阔草地、湖面与适合放松呼吸的城市绿量。
locations.address: No. 33 Kehui Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市朝阳区科荟路33号
tips: Go in late afternoon for softer light and cooler temperatures.
Pick your gate in advance because the park is huge.
tipsCn: 建议傍晚前往，光线和体感都更舒适。
公园很大，出发前最好先确定入口。

locations.name: Summer Palace
locations.description: The imperial lake-and-hill landscape that gives you Beijing at its most expansive and composed.
locations.descriptionCn: 帝都山水园林的集大成者，也是体验“北京的开阔感”最直接的地方之一。
locations.address: No. 19 Xinjiangongmen Road, Haidian District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市海淀区新建宫门路19号
tips: Reserve a longer block than you expect; the grounds are vast.
Boat and lakeside routes are more pleasant outside peak midday heat.
tipsCn: 建议比预期多留时间，园区真的很大。
如果不是盛夏正午，湖边和乘船路线会更舒服。

locations.name: Beihai Park
locations.description: A central lake park with one of the most graceful slow-walking circuits inside the old city.
locations.descriptionCn: 老城中心非常优雅的湖面公园，也是最适合慢走的一条城市自然线。
locations.address: No. 1 Wenjin Street, Xicheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市西城区文津街1号
tips: Best when combined with Jingshan or the Palace Museum.
Try to circle part of the lake instead of only doing the main entrance axis.
tipsCn: 很适合和景山或故宫安排在同一天。
不要只走主入口轴线，尽量沿湖多绕一段。

locations.name: Jingshan Park
locations.description: The quickest elevated view over Beijing's historic core and the Forbidden City roofs.
locations.descriptionCn: 俯瞰故宫屋顶和北京老城中轴线最直接的高点之一。
locations.address: No. 44 Jingshan West Street, Xicheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市西城区景山西街44号
tips: Sunset is especially strong if the air is clear.
Climb directly to the top first, then explore the rest of the park.
tipsCn: 天气好的傍晚尤其值得上来。
建议先直接登顶，再慢慢逛园子其余部分。

locations.name: Chaoyang Park
locations.description: A large east-Beijing leisure park that works well when you want an easier local reset than the more famous imperial gardens.
locations.descriptionCn: 东北京非常实用的大型休闲公园，如果想找比皇家园林更轻松的城市放松点，这里很合适。
locations.address: No. 1 Chaoyang Park South Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市朝阳区朝阳公园南路1号
tips: Good for jogging, casual walking, or a slow morning after a late night.
Pair it with nearby CBD or Sanlitun plans.
tipsCn: 很适合慢跑、散步，或者熬夜后的轻松早晨。
很适合和CBD或三里屯行程串起来。

locations.name: PUMCH International Medical Services
locations.description: A reliable English-capable medical fallback for visitors, backed by Peking Union Medical College Hospital's strongest specialist network.
locations.descriptionCn: 适合访客应急与英文沟通的稳妥医疗后备点，依托协和医院成熟的专科体系。
locations.address: 1 Shuaifuyuan, Wangfujing, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区王府井帅府园1号
tips: Use the official PUMCH app to book outpatient appointments in advance.
Save the hospital name in Chinese before calling a ride.
tipsCn: 门诊建议提前通过协和官方 App 预约。
打车前先保存医院中文名称会更方便。

locations.name: Dongzhimen Airport Express Transfer
locations.nameCn: 东直门机场快线换乘点
locations.description: A key transfer point between the Capital Airport Express and central Beijing, useful when you want the fastest rail connection into the city.
locations.descriptionCn: 首都机场快线进入市区的重要换乘点，适合需要快速铁路进城的访客。
locations.address: Dongzhimen Transport Hub, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区东直门交通枢纽
tips: Avoid rush hour if you are carrying large luggage.
It is especially convenient for stays in Dongcheng or Chaoyang.
tipsCn: 携带大件行李时尽量避开高峰时段。
如果住在东城或朝阳，这里通常是最顺手的换乘点。

locations.name: Beijing Capital International Airport Terminal 3
locations.nameCn: 北京首都国际机场T3航站楼
locations.description: The most common international arrival point for visitors entering Beijing, with direct airport rail into the city.
locations.descriptionCn: 国际访客进入北京最常见的抵达点之一，并可直接换乘机场快线进城。
locations.address: Terminal 3, Beijing Capital International Airport, Chaoyang District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市朝阳区北京首都国际机场T3航站楼
tips: Airport Express is usually faster than a taxi during heavy traffic.
Download payment and translation tools before landing if possible.
tipsCn: 遇到拥堵时，机场快线通常比打车更快。
如果可以，最好在落地前准备好支付和翻译工具。

locations.name: Beijing South Railway Station
locations.description: The high-speed rail gateway for trips to Tianjin, Shanghai, and beyond; useful when the workshop extends into regional travel.
locations.descriptionCn: 连接天津、上海等方向的高铁枢纽，适合需要继续城际移动的参与者。
locations.address: No. 12 Yongdingmenwai Street, Fengtai District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市丰台区永定门外大街12号
tips: Leave extra time because the station is large and security lines vary.
Food options improve after you clear the main entry gates.
tipsCn: 车站很大，安检排队波动也大，建议预留时间。
过了主入口安检后再找吃的通常更高效。

locations.name: Bank of China Wangfujing Branch
locations.description: A central branch useful for international card support, exchange questions, or account-related errands in the core city area.
locations.descriptionCn: 位于中心城区，适合处理跨境银行卡、兑换或账户相关事务。
locations.address: No. 218 Wangfujing Avenue, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区王府井大街218号
tips: Weekday mornings are usually the smoothest.
Bring passport and local phone number if your request is account-related.
tipsCn: 工作日上午通常最顺畅。
如果涉及账户业务，最好带好护照和本地手机号。

locations.name: Taikoo Li Sanlitun
locations.description: Beijing's clearest concentration of global retail, bars, fashion, and people-watching — the easiest place to feel the city's cosmopolitan night energy.
locations.descriptionCn: 北京最集中的国际零售、酒吧、时尚与人流观察场之一，也是感受城市夜生活的直接入口。
locations.address: No. 19 Sanlitun Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市朝阳区三里屯路19号
tips: Best after dusk when the district fully lights up.
Use it as a meeting point before choosing a bar or late dinner spot nearby.
tipsCn: 最佳到访时间是入夜之后，街区氛围更完整。
可以先把这里作为集合点，再决定去附近哪家酒吧或晚餐。

locations.name: Sanlitun Bar Street
locations.description: Still one of the easiest shorthand answers to “where should we go out tonight in Beijing?”
locations.descriptionCn: 如果有人问“今晚在北京去哪儿”，这里仍然是最直接的标准答案之一。
locations.address: Sanlitun Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市朝阳区三里屯路
tips: Go later if you want the full crowd, earlier if you want easier seating.
Keep the first venue simple and move once the group settles in.
tipsCn: 想感受最热闹的气氛就晚点去，想轻松找位子就早点到。
如果是多人出行，第一站先选简单一点更好。

locations.name: Houhai Bar Area
locations.description: A more atmospheric old-Beijing nightlife zone where lake views and hutong edges matter as much as the drinks.
locations.descriptionCn: 更有“老北京夜色”氛围的夜生活区域，湖边和胡同的气质和酒本身一样重要。
locations.address: Around Houhai and Shichahai, Xicheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市西城区后海与什刹海周边
tips: Go for atmosphere rather than the city's most cutting-edge cocktail program.
Works best on nights when you want to stroll between venues.
tipsCn: 这里更适合看氛围，不一定是全城最前沿的酒单。
如果想一边走一边换店，这片区域会很好用。

locations.name: Great Leap Brewing #6
locations.description: A dependable craft-beer stop for groups that want something casual, social, and distinctly Beijing-built rather than generic hotel-bar energy.
locations.descriptionCn: 适合多人轻松聊天的精酿啤酒点位，比酒店酒吧更有北京本地社群感。
locations.address: No. 6 Doujiao Hutong, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区豆角胡同6号
tips: Good for a first round before moving elsewhere.
If you go with a group, order shared snacks early.
tipsCn: 很适合作为夜晚的第一站。
如果是多人同行，最好早点把小食一起点上。

locations.name: Modernista
locations.description: A long-running favorite for live music, dancing, and a less polished but more characterful night than the big commercial zones.
locations.descriptionCn: 北京持续受欢迎的现场音乐与跳舞场所之一，相比大型商业夜区更有个性。
locations.address: No. 44 Baochao Hutong, Dongcheng District, Beijing
locations.addressCn: 北京市东城区宝钞胡同44号
tips: Check the event schedule before you go.
It gets better later in the evening than right at opening.
tipsCn: 出发前最好先看当晚活动安排。
通常越晚气氛越好，不必太早到。
